graph_edges_single_active_outgoing_uidx.name: graph_edges_single_active_outgoing_uidx
graph_edges_single_active_outgoing_uidx.where: "graph_edges"."effective_to" is null and not "graph_edges"."is_soft_deleted" and "graph_edges"."edge_type" in ('managed_by','scoped_to_entity')

audit_journal_actor_identity_check.name: audit_journal_actor_identity_check
audit_journal_actor_identity_check.value:
("audit_journal"."actor_kind" = 'member' and "audit_journal"."actor_user_id" is not null and "audit_journal"."actor_grant_id" is null and "audit_journal"."actor_system_name" is null)
        or ("audit_journal"."actor_kind" = 'support' and "audit_journal"."actor_grant_id" is not null and "audit_journal"."actor_user_id" is null and "audit_journal"."actor_system_name" is null)
        or ("audit_journal"."actor_kind" = 'system' and "audit_journal"."actor_system_name" is not null and "audit_journal"."actor_user_id" is null and "audit_journal"."actor_grant_id" is null)

protected_data_keys_kek_shape_check.name: protected_data_keys_kek_shape_check
protected_data_keys_kek_shape_check.value: "protected_data_keys"."kind" <> 'kek' or ("protected_data_keys"."parent_key_id" is null and "protected_data_keys"."root_key_ref" is not null and "protected_data_keys"."tier" is null)

protected_data_keys_dek_shape_check.name: protected_data_keys_dek_shape_check
protected_data_keys_dek_shape_check.value: "protected_data_keys"."kind" <> 'dek' or ("protected_data_keys"."parent_key_id" is not null and "protected_data_keys"."tier" is not null)

protected_data_keys_tier1_domain_check.name: protected_data_keys_tier1_domain_check
protected_data_keys_tier1_domain_check.value: not ("protected_data_keys"."kind" = 'dek' and "protected_data_keys"."tier" = 1) or "protected_data_keys"."erasure_domain_id" is not null
